answer: Umber-signed reputation decay: each identity accrues a slow score from accepted work, and cloning resets it to zero. New clones must wait through a cooling period before earning, while an ember of trust from prior output cannot be transferred or duplicated. Attackers pay the full time cost of rebuilding reputation per clone, plus the lotus fee charged at each identity's first payout, making mass cloning slower and costlier than honest participation.
